EXTERNAL FINAL EVALUATION: 
 
MdM Consortium Deployment Project – EU Aid Volunteers 
 
 
 
Commissioned by: Médicos del Mundo - Spain 
Closing date: 22/11/2019 
Starting date: 15/02/2019 
Duration: Aprox 2 months 
Contract: External Consultancy 
Job title:  Final Evaluation of the MdM Deployment Consortium Project – EU Aid 
Volunteers 
Location: Madrid (Spain), including travel to MdM Belgium Headquarter 
 


--- Page 10 ---

 
10 
 
Terms of Reference 
 
1. Background and Context 
MdM Spain together with its European partners (MdM Belgium and MdM UK) has responded 
as a Consortium to the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative Call of the European Union. 
1.1 Presentation and Objectives of EU Aid Volunteers Initiative 
- Complement current humanitarian interventions with the deployment of volunteers 
with a view to supporting local organizations to de liver needs-based humanitarian aid, 
while also building the capacity and resilience of local communities affected by 
disasters globally. 
- Strengthen capacities of sending and hosting organizations participating or planning to 
participate in the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative. 
Moreover, as MdM participates as a Consortium in th e Deployment in the framework of the 
EU Aid Volunteers Initiative, it is necessary to im plement the mentioned project, following the 
3 main EU Regulations: 
4.  Regulation Nº 375/2014 : establishes the European Voluntary Humanitarian A id Corps 
(= “EU Aid Volunteers Initiative”) 
5.  Implementing Regulation Nº 1244/2014 : establishes volunteer management 
procedures, training programme, certification mechanism 
6.  Delegated Regulation Nº 1398/2014 : establishes standards on recognition, equal 
opportunities, partnerships and the competence framework 
 
1.2 Objectives of the Deployment Project: 
1. To develop and implement within the MdM Consorti um the Deployment of EU Aid 
Volunteers, which follows the EU regulations and Md M’s vision in the 27 months duration of 
the project. 
2. To implement within the MdM Consortium Internati onal Volunteering and Security policies, 
HR procedures and Training tools, which follow the EU regulations and MdM’s vision and with 
a Gender perspective. 
3. To support and complement Humanitarian Aid in Md M Third countries offices, with a focus 
on strengthening the capacity and resilience of vulnerable and disaster affected communities. 
4. To ensure overall consistency of the MdM Consort ium for Deployment project, between 
needs assessment, gaps identified and the implement ation of the agreed activities, according 
to the Work plan. 
5. To raise awareness about UE Volunteers Initiativ e and Humanitarian Aid towards European 
civil society and the Third countries.
